description: The three Nord Stage 4 hardware variants. All share an identical control deck; they differ only in the keybed (count, range, action) and overall silhouette. Each benchmark run targets exactly one variant, chosen at run creation.

variants.label: Stage 4 88
variants.note: Full-size flagship. Identical control deck to the 73; widest keybed. Measure silhouette bounds and aspect ratio from the reference image before scoring geometry.

variants.label: Stage 4 73
variants.note: Default benchmark target. Fully measured from the reference image.

variants.label: Stage 4 Compact 73
variants.note: Semi-weighted waterfall keybed: square key fronts with no hammer-action front lip. Identical control deck to the HA models. Measure silhouette bounds and aspect ratio from the reference image; do not reuse the HA73 keybed geometry.
